items.reason: Describes the same unguarded sender/login metadata lookup that raises KeyError when sender metadata is absent.
Describes the unhandled failures from get_user_info() in the new OAuth step, which produce a 500 instead of the installation error page.
Describes accepting an empty installation_id because validation checks only for None. None of the golden issues covers this validation problem.
Describes the same loss of static translation extraction caused by calling _(error_short) on a variable while supplying untranslated literals.
Describes the same missing sender metadata guard and resulting KeyError in the ownership check.
Describes the same direct sender/login metadata indexing that crashes when the metadata is missing.

Alleges an invalid webhook HMAC makes test_github_user_mismatch pass without exercising the ownership check. Issue #10 concerns a different test bypassing its intended path through an incorrect OAuth state; fixing that would not fix this alleged problem.
